Summary: The sources define joint precision and recall in HotpotQA as products of answer and supporting-fact precision and recall, respectively, and joint F1 as their harmonic mean. For example, joint precision is calculated as P(joint) = P(ans) × P(sup), and joint recall as R(joint) = R(ans) × R(sup). Joint F1 is derived conventionally from these joint precision and recall values. The sources also mention that baseline performance statistics show joint EM/F1 values ranging from 11–12 / 40–41 in distractor settings and 2.6 / 17.8 in full wiki settings.
